settings.how.title: How CartGuard decides
settings.how.description: Every checkout goes through these steps in order. The first rule an order breaks stops it.
settings.how.step1: Blocked countries are always stopped, even for trusted customers.
settings.how.step2: Trusted customers who are signed in skip every other rule.
settings.how.step3: Order quantities and the order total are checked against your limits.
settings.how.step4: Delivery addresses are checked for PO Boxes, military addresses, blocked words and specific addresses.
settings.how.step5: Blocked states, cities and postal codes are checked.
settings.how.failOpen: If CartGuard ever runs into a problem, checkout stays open instead of blocking customers.

fields.vipAddresses.label: Trusted street addresses

privacy.title: CartGuard Privacy Policy
privacy.overview.heading: 1. Overview
privacy.overview.body: CartGuard is a Shopify app that validates carts and checkouts (PO Box and military address blocking, quantity and order amount limits, geographic restrictions and a VIP allowlist). We don't sell or share personal data.
privacy.store.heading: 2. Data we store
privacy.store.session: Store session: your shop domain, the access token Shopify issues to CartGuard and the granted permissions. It's kept in our database so the app can work, and deleted when you uninstall CartGuard or Shopify asks us to erase shop data.
privacy.store.rules: Your rules: saved in your own store as app-owned Shopify metafields. If you add customer email addresses or street addresses to the VIP allowlist, they are stored there.
privacy.store.language: Language: the language you picked in CartGuard, stored against your shop domain so the app opens in your language.
privacy.read.heading: 3. Data we read but don't store
privacy.read.checkout: Checkout: rules run inside Shopify's infrastructure (Shopify Functions). The buyer's email, delivery address and cart are checked in memory and never sent to CartGuard's servers.
privacy.read.impact: Impact Checker: when you check or save rules, CartGuard reads up to your 100 most recent orders (email, shipping address, products) to estimate how many would have been blocked. This data is processed in memory and not stored.
privacy.gdpr.heading: 4. GDPR and privacy requests
privacy.gdpr.dataRequest: customers/data_request: we check whether the customer's email or addresses appear in your VIP allowlist and provide those entries to you on request.
privacy.gdpr.redact: customers/redact: we remove the customer's email and addresses from your VIP allowlist.
privacy.gdpr.shopRedact: shop/redact: we delete all stored sessions for your shop.
privacy.contact.heading: 5. Contact
privacy.contact.body: For privacy questions or support, email {email}.
